metric_definitions.EA_pct: per-hypothesis exact evidence-set accuracy * 100; independent of label correctness
metric_definitions.MI_Gap_pct: mean(Gap(agent raw_perf)); clip each agent before averaging
metric_definitions.aggregation: per trace/agent metric, then equal-weight repeats within task, then equal-weight tasks
metric_definitions.missing: missing/failed/unverified artifacts do not contribute scores; incomplete main cells are null
metric_definitions.usage: trace counters cover returned logical calls; retry and hidden usage require raw API dumps

resources.notes: Subprocess totals include preserved promoted pilot attempts plus current stage, deduplicated by job/start/end/pid. Agent and subprocess sums double-count concurrent time. Span includes pilot-to-full idle gaps. Simulated cost is budget accounting, not Slurm wall time. Trace usage may exclude unsuccessful HTTP attempts.
